# T-3: Wire PostWorktree

## Goal
Invoke PostWorktree immediately after worktree creation in prepare flow while preserving existing prepare success behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- PostWorktree receives { CWD: worktreePath } after git worktree add succeeds.
- PostWorktree command execution cwd is worktreePath.
- Spec/draft creation continues when hook result is ok:false.
- Existing prepare behavior is unchanged when PostWorktree is not configured.

## Implementation Notes
Modify only the useWorktree branch in src/flow/lib/run-prepare-spec.js. Do not add hook calls for branch or spec-only mode.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local integration-style test using controlled command stubs or observable side effects to confirm call order and non-blocking behavior.
